manual_pass.reason: Lead accepts every finished or stopped run as a valid result (2026-11-16)

interview.hardest_part: Precise boss combat and platforming under 0.4-second discrete actions, especially defeating Moss Mother, Bell Beast, and Widow while navigating Pharloom without dash early on.
interview.likely_failure: Dying repeatedly to Moss Mother or Bell Beast, or getting lost and losing time before reaching the later required bosses and the Citadel.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Health masks, silk binding, benches for healing and respawn, persistent notes across attempts, the pause menu, and the ability to hold jump for higher jumps.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Coarse 0.4-second input steps, limited reaction precision, difficult enemy and hazard timing, complex room navigation, and no dash at the start make platforming and bosses punishing.
